b.pair_to_edge = function(v1,v2,layer_k = 4,rm.last = F){
  xy =data.frame()
  for(i in seq(0,layer_k)){
   tmp = v1*i+(layer_k-i)*v2
   xy = rbind(xy,data.frame(x = tmp[1],y = tmp[2]))
  }
  if(rm.last){
    xy = xy[-dim(xy)[1],]
  }
  return(xy)
}

make_cc_borad = function(cc_size = 4){
  b0 = c(1,0)
  b1 = c(cos(pi/3),sin(pi/3))
  bv =list(b0,b1,b1-b0,-b0,-b1,b0-b1)
  
  b.pair0 = data.frame(v1 = seq(1,6)) %>% mutate(v2 =1 + v1%%6)
  df.in = data.frame(v1 = 0, v2 = 0,x = 0,y = 0,layer_k = 0)
  
  for(ii in 1:cc_size){
    b.pair = b.pair0
    b.pair = b.pair %>% mutate(edge.point = map2(v1,v2,~b.pair_to_edge(bv[[.x]],bv[[.y]],ii,rm.last = T)))
    tmp = b.pair %>%unnest(edge.point)
    tmp$layer_k = ii
    df.in = rbind(df.in,tmp)
  }
  #plot(y~x, df.in,asp = 1)
  
  b.pair0 = data.frame(v1 = 1+(3+seq(0,5))%%6) %>% 
      mutate(v2 =1 + v1%%6) %>% mutate(v0 = map2(v1,v2,~-bv[[.x]]-bv[[.y]])) %>%
      mutate(xv = map_dbl(v0,~.x[1]),yv = map_dbl(v0,~.x[2]) )%>%select(-v0)
  
  df.out = b.pair0%>%mutate(x = 0,y = 0,layer_k = 0)
  for(ii in 1:(cc_size-1)){
    b.pair = b.pair0
    b.pair = b.pair %>% mutate(edge.point = map2(v1,v2,~b.pair_to_edge(bv[[.x]],bv[[.y]],ii,rm.last = F)))
    tmp = b.pair %>%unnest(edge.point)
    tmp$layer_k = ii
    df.out = rbind(df.out,tmp)
  }
  #plot(y~x, df.out,asp = 1)
  
  df = rbind(df.in%>%mutate(xv = 0, yv = 0),df.out) %>% 
          mutate(xf = x +cc_size*xv, yf = y+cc_size*yv,
                 block = ifelse(xv == 0 & yv==0,"0_0",paste(v1,v2,sep = "_")))
  cc_color = c("grey90","magenta","red","orange","yellow","green","blue")
  names(cc_color) = levels(factor(df$block))
  df = df%>% mutate(cc_color = cc_color[block])
  return(df)
}

cc_color = c("grey90","magenta","red","orange","yellow","green","blue")
df = make_cc_borad(4)
df %>% ggplot(aes(x = xf, y = yf))+
    geom_point(color = "black",size = 8)+
    geom_point(aes(color = factor(block)),size = 7)+
    theme_void()+coord_fixed()+
    scale_color_manual(values = cc_color)+
    theme(legend.position = "none")
